claims.content: To maintain Voucher Service Provider records in the VSP master by entering the required VSP Code, Providers Name, and all other mandatory service-provider information.

scope_contract.goal_statement: To maintain Voucher Service Provider records in the VSP master by entering the required VSP Code, Providers Name, and all other mandatory service-provider information.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: VMU User creates a Voucher Service Provider record in the VSP master with VSP Code and Provider Name, supplying all mandatory information; Contact No and E-Mail Id are optional.
scope_contract.start_boundary: VMU User begins entering a Voucher Service Provider record in the VSP master.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The VSP master contains the Voucher Service Provider record with the required VSP Code and Provider Name information.
in_scope_actions: Enter VSP Code and Provider Name for the Voucher Service Provider record
Optionally provide Contact No and E-Mail Id
excluded_adjacent_actions: Patient follow-up for monitoring proper operation of the voucher scheme

claims.content: The system automatically generates the VSP Code as a digit code with suffix SP for the new Voucher Service Provider record.
The system lists District, Sub-District, County, Sub-County, and Village/Town from the master during VSP creation.
The system lists Health Sub-District, Locality, Level Of Facility, Type of facility, and Registration Body from their respective masters for selection.
The VMU User enters the Providers Name.

The VMU User selects the required District, Sub-District, County, Sub-County, Village/Town, Health Sub-District, Locality, Level Of Facility, Type of facility, and Registration Body values from the listed masters and enters the remaining mandatory service-provider details, including Physical Address, Communication Address, Contact Person, Designation, and Status.
The VMU User optionally enters Contact No and E-Mail Id; all other information is mandatory.
The system creates the Voucher Service Provider record in the VSP master with the generated VSP Code, Provider Name, and supplied mandatory service-provider information.

If the VMU User selects 'No' in response to the duplicate Provider Name message, the system does not allow the new VSP entry to be saved.
If the VMU User selects 'Yes' in response to the duplicate Provider Name message, the system allows the new VSP entry to be saved.
